"GAME DEVELOPMENT PROMPT: WORLD-CLASS BATTLE ROYALE GAME

1. GAME TITLE

Create a professional 3D mobile battle royale game called BATTLE WORLD: ELITE SURVIVAL.

The game must be an original, high-quality, action-packed survival shooter inspired by the battle royale genre of games like Free Fire. Do not copy copyrighted game assets, maps, characters, or logos. Create original characters, weapons, environments, and branding.

2. PLATFORM AND GAME ENGINE

- Build the game primarily for Android mobile phones.
- Use a real-time 3D game engine.
- Optimize the graphics and performance for low-end, medium-range, and high-end Android devices.
- Provide touch controls and customizable button layouts.
- Create a working, playable game rather than just a visual demonstration.
- Include all necessary game files, scripts, scenes, assets, and configuration.
- Provide a method to build and export an installable Android APK.
- If you cannot create the entire game in one generation, build it in organized, working stages without pretending unfinished features are complete.

3. MAIN GAME MODE

Create an online multiplayer battle royale game.

- Support up to 50 real players per match when server capacity permits.
- If 50 players are not possible in the first version, make the player count configurable and start with a smaller working match.
- Players enter a large island and fight to survive.
- Players can explore, collect weapons, find ammunition, collect protective equipment, and use medical supplies.
- The playable zone gradually shrinks, forcing players toward the center.
- Players outside the safe zone receive damage.
- The last surviving player or team wins.
- Add solo, duo, and squad modes.
- Include an optional practice mode with computer-controlled enemies.
- Add a spectator mode for eliminated players where appropriate.
- Include a proper matchmaking system and dedicated authoritative servers for fair online play.

4. OPEN-WORLD MAP

Create a detailed, original 3D island with different locations, including:

- A modern city with tall buildings.
- Abandoned military bases.
- Villages and houses.
- Forests, hills, and mountains.
- Rivers, lakes, and bridges.
- An industrial area.
- An airport and hangars.
- A harbor and beach.
- Hidden loot locations.
- Underground bunkers.
- Watchtowers and sniper positions.

Allow players to run, walk, crouch, jump, climb where supported, swim where appropriate, and drive vehicles.

Add a minimap, a full map, a compass, and visible safe-zone boundaries.

5. CHARACTERS

Create a collection of original, high-quality 3D characters.

Include:

- Character selection.
- Different outfits and hairstyles.
- Character animations.
- Running, jumping, crouching, aiming, shooting, reloading, and victory animations.
- Character customization.
- Unlockable skins and cosmetic rewards.
- A player profile showing level, experience, victories, eliminations, and statistics.

Cosmetic items must not unfairly increase combat power.

6. WEAPONS AND EQUIPMENT

Add multiple weapon categories:

- Assault rifles.
- Submachine guns.
- Shotguns.
- Sniper rifles.
- Pistols.
- Light machine guns.
- Melee weapons.
- Grenades and other balanced tactical equipment.

Each weapon must have its own damage, range, recoil, accuracy, ammunition capacity, reload time, and firing behavior.

Add:

- Scopes and sights.
- Extended magazines.
- Weapon attachments.
- Body armor and helmets.
- Backpacks with limited inventory capacity.
- Ammunition.
- Health and recovery items.
- Weapon switching and pickup systems.

Create a realistic but accessible mobile shooting experience. Include hit detection, damage calculation, reload animations, sound effects, and server-validated combat.

7. MOBILE CONTROLS

Create smooth, responsive mobile controls with:

- A virtual joystick for movement.
- Camera movement by dragging.
- Aim and shoot buttons.
- Jump and crouch buttons.
- Sprint.
- Reload.
- Weapon switching.
- Inventory.
- Map.
- Interaction and pickup
"
